<a id="&lt;init&gt;()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>TextStyle</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;TextStyle()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a default set of styling options for the text of a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMarker</code></a> that consists of
 the following values:
 <ul>
 <li>Text size: 18 pixels</li>
 <li>Text color: opaque white</li>
 <li>Text outline size: 0 pixels</li>
 <li>Text outline color: opaque black</li>
 <li>Text placement: <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-placement#BOTTOM"><code>MapMarker.TextStyle.Placement.BOTTOM</code></a></li>
 </ul>
 <p>Once the resulting <code>TextStyle</code> is applied to a <code>MapMarker</code>, its text will be centered over its
 image. The font will be 18 pixels wide, colored opaque white and will have no visible outline.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(double,com.here.sdk.core.Color,double,com.here.sdk.core.Color,java.util.List)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>TextStyle</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;TextStyle&#8203;(double&nbsp;textSize,
                 @NonNull
                 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;textColor,
                 double&nbsp;textOutlineSize,
                 @NonNull
                 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;textOutlineColor,
                 @NonNull
                 java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-placement" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMarker.TextStyle.Placement</a>&gt;&nbsp;placements)
          throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMarker.TextStyle.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a set of styling options for the text of a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMarker</code></a>.
 <p>List of placements is used to specify allowed placement of text relative to the icon.
 When marker overlapping is allowed as set by <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker#setOverlapAllowed(boolean)"><code>MapMarker.setOverlapAllowed(boolean)</code></a>,
 only first placement element is considered.
 Otherwise the placement value is chosen so that the text does not overlap
 with other <code>MapMarker</code> instances.
 <p>Placement values are prioritized according
 to the order in which they appear in the list. Lists with duplicate entries
 as well as empty lists are not supported.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>textSize</code> - <p>The size of the text in pixels.
     Only positive values are supported.</dd>
<dd><code>textColor</code> - <p>The text color.</dd>
<dd><code>textOutlineSize</code> - <p>The size of the text outline in pixels.
     Only non-negative values are supported.</dd>
<dd><code>textOutlineColor</code> - <p>The color of the text outline.</dd>
<dd><code>placements</code> - <p>List of allowed placements of the text relative to the icon of a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMarker</code></a>.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMarker.TextStyle.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(double,com.here.sdk.core.Color,double,com.here.sdk.core.Color,java.util.List,java.lang.String)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>TextStyle</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;TextStyle&#8203;(double&nbsp;textSize,
                 @NonNull
                 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;textColor,
                 double&nbsp;textOutlineSize,
                 @NonNull
                 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;textOutlineColor,
                 @NonNull
                 java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-placement" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMarker.TextStyle.Placement</a>&gt;&nbsp;placements,
                 @NonNull
                 java.lang.String&nbsp;fontName)
          throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMarker.TextStyle.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a set of styling options for the text of a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMarker</code></a>.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behavior. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.
 <p>List of placements is used to specify allowed placement of text relative to the icon.
 When marker overlapping is allowed as set by <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker#setOverlapAllowed(boolean)"><code>MapMarker.setOverlapAllowed(boolean)</code></a>,
 only first placement element is considered.
 Otherwise the placement value is chosen so that the text does not overlap
 with other <code>MapMarker</code> instances.
 <p>Placement values are prioritized according
 to the order in which they appear in the list. Lists with duplicate entries
 as well as empty lists are not supported.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>textSize</code> - <p>The size of the text in pixels.
     Only positive values are supported.</dd>
<dd><code>textColor</code> - <p>The text color.</dd>
<dd><code>textOutlineSize</code> - <p>The size of the text outline in pixels.
     Only non-negative values are supported.</dd>
<dd><code>textOutlineColor</code> - <p>The color of the text outline.</dd>
<dd><code>placements</code> - <p>List of allowed placements of the text relative to the icon of a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMarker</code></a>.</dd>
<dd><code>fontName</code> - <p>Font name, registered with <code>AssetsManager.registerFont</code>.
     If empty string is provided, a default font will be used.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarker-textstyle-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMarker.TextStyle.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
